generations.prompt: Night in the moonlit courtyard; the camera is locked off on the young man in the wine-red velvet doublet, from the waist up, his face lit from below by the phone in his left hand, a white earbud in his right ear; vertical frame. He looks up toward the balcony and speaks with great feeling, exactly these words: "Were I the dew, I would consent to fall, if falling were toward you." Then he waits for her reply; his face goes blank and bored; he looks down at the phone and scrolls with his thumb. He is the only person in the frame and the only one who speaks. The camera does not move. Sound: his voice clearly, crickets, the fountain; no music. No on-screen text, no captions, no lettering anywhere.
